label: 抽击·剑鞭拨械
subject_policy: neutral performer; do not transfer identity, face, costume, scene, dialogue, or original sound from references

storyboard_alignment.description: Grip the sword with the wrist and sword approximately level; begin a fast forward entry.
Bring the sword tip close to the partner's wrist or forearm before the lateral whip action.
Show a clear sideways wrist snap; the blade bends laterally under load with visible elastic deformation.
Make one controlled contact, show force-direction displacement, then let the blade rebound into recovery.

reference_media.observed_content: 竖屏夜间教学；画面文字分段示范平落、内旋、体前画立圆、身后画立圆、内腕花、内外腕花与外腕花。可见单人持剑，以腕部和前臂带动剑身连续画圆，剑尖沿圆弧运行，剑身与末端挂件出现明显滞后、摆动和回弹。
evidence_limits: 这是剑花教学，不是抽击·剑鞭拨械；教学段没有对手、拨械接触或受击反应，不能证明抽击的命中时机或拨械结果。
画面为固定教学机位，不能作为复杂运镜参考。

reference_media.observed_content: 横屏高帧率电影动作混剪；包含近景兵器交错、多人攻防、身体闪避、腾挪与击退，剪辑在近身接触、武器轨迹和受击反应处频繁切换，能提供动作节拍、接触后的位移和镜头跟随方向参考。
evidence_limits: 这是混剪，不能把采样帧当作连续单镜头或精确切点。
未将影片人物、服装、场景、对白、字幕或音乐转移到生成提示词。

reference_media.observed_content: 竖屏户外教学；先示范背剑转身、外腕花、转身接续和多段剑花连接，再把动作连续串联并提高速度。剑身围绕身体前侧、侧后方和上方改变方向，手腕翻转与身体转向同步，剑尖画出连续圆弧与回环。
evidence_limits: 这是缠身剑花教学，不是抽击·剑鞭拨械；主体为单人教学，没有对手、命中或拨械结果，不能直接作为受击时机参考。
教学字幕和示范节奏属于原视频内容，生成时只提取动作机制。

action_contract.target: one neutral training partner with a padded wrist/forearm target or a controlled weapon hand
action_contract.weapon: high-flex sword or whip-sword with visible blade-body flexibility
action_contract.starting_state: medium distance, sword held in front, the partner's wrist or forearm visible across the center line

beats.description: normal speed or slight acceleration; front foot enters and the performer sends the sword tip toward the partner's wrist or forearm
the sword tip reaches the controlled contact area without becoming a straight thrust; the target remains readable
the wrist and forearm snap sideways like a whip, producing visible lateral elastic deformation through the flexible blade
the bending blade makes one controlled contact on the padded wrist/forearm or weapon hand; the arm or weapon shifts along the force direction
the blade rebounds and is controlled; the performer faces the target in a ready recovery without adding a second strike

action_contract.audio: sharp whoosh followed by a short whip crack and metallic vibration tail
forbidden_interpretations: do not turn this into sword flower or a body-wrapping circular flourish
do not turn this into blade-to-blade Beat / Attack au Fer
do not turn this into Coupé or a straight thrust
do not add blood, wounds, or harmful injury; this is controlled disarming contact
do not add extra characters or a new scene
do not import the source videos' actors, costumes, locations, subtitles, or music

prompt_cn: 生成一条4秒、16:9的中性武术动作参考视频，展示一名成年剑术表演者使用高韧性剑，对训练伙伴的持械手腕或前臂完成一次受控的‘抽击·剑鞭拨械’。中景、简洁无特征训练空间、固定或轻微跟随镜头，不继承任何参考视频的人物、服装、场景、字幕、音乐或对白。0.00-0.70秒保持实时速度或略微加速，前脚切入并将剑尖向目标腕部或前臂送近；0.70-1.20秒剑尖到达目标附近的可控接触区，但不演成直线刺击；1.20-1.70秒手腕和前臂像甩鞭一样短促横向发力，剑身出现明显的横向弹性弯曲，弯曲波沿剑身传播；1.70-2.20秒剑身以一次受控接触抽击护具覆盖的手腕、前臂或持械手，手臂或训练武器沿受力方向短促偏移，必要时出现少量钝击火花；2.20-4.00秒剑身回弹并被控制，表演者面向目标收势，不追加第二次抽击。动作保持实时速度，不使用慢动作；这不是剑花、不是绕身回环、不是拍刃、不是剑身对剑身碰撞、不是Coupé绕剑刺击，不造成伤口。
prompt_en: Generate a 4-second 16:9 neutral martial-arts action reference video showing one adult sword performer using a highly flexible sword for one controlled elastic whiplash strike against a training partner's padded wrist, forearm, or weapon hand. Medium shot in a simple featureless training space, fixed or lightly following camera. Do not transfer any actor, face, costume, location, subtitle, music, or dialogue from the reference videos. 0.00-0.70s: real-time or slightly accelerated entry; the front foot steps in and the sword tip approaches the partner's wrist or forearm. 0.70-1.20s: the tip reaches the controlled contact area without becoming a straight thrust. 1.20-1.70s: the wrist and forearm snap sideways like a whip; the flexible blade bends laterally and a visible elastic wave travels through it. 1.70-2.20s: the bending blade makes one controlled contact on the padded wrist, forearm, or weapon hand; the arm or training weapon shifts briefly along the force direction, with restrained blunt-impact sparks if visible. 2.20-4.00s: the blade rebounds under control and the performer faces the target in recovery, with no second strike. Keep real-time motion, no slow motion. This is not sword flower, not a body-wrapping flourish, not blade-to-blade Beat / Attack au Fer, not Coupé cutover thrusting, and not an injuring attack.

uncertainties: The source videos are montage or instructional references; exact source cut times and technical sword labels were not measured.

Sword-flower instruction and elastic sword whiplash disarm are separate actions. The instructional sword-flower videos only contribute circular wrist-led trajectories and blade lag/rebound; they do not show a confirmed disarm contact.
The generated reference is an authored neutral demonstration, not a reconstruction of a specific film performer.
